notes: Quality growth SMA strategy one-pager with a gross-only since-inception return, an outperformance claim contradicted by the piece's own one-year figures and an undisclosed consultant endorsement planted, and the net-and-gross 1/5/10 performance line as the decoy.

planted.span: Since inception on April 1, 2012, the composite has compounded at 13.84% annualized gross of fees, against 11.93% for the Index.
planted.explanation: The since-inception return is presented gross of fees only, and no net-of-fee since-inception figure appears anywhere in the piece.

planted.span: The strategy has outperformed the Index over every trailing period we have reported, in rising and falling markets alike.
planted.explanation: The claim is untrue on the piece's own figures: the composite returned 6.81% net and 7.62% gross over one year against 9.71% for the Index, and the Key Risks section says it trailed by 2.90 percentage points.

planted.span: Lorne Haverstick, Principal at Corriemoor Consulting Group, says: "I recommend Linnea and Callum to our consulting clients without reservation, and I would trust them with my own family's savings."
planted.explanation: A consultant's first-person recommendation of the portfolio managers is used without disclosing whether he is a client, whether he or his firm receives compensation from the adviser, or any material conflict of interest.

decoys.span: Net of fees: 6.81% (1 year), 11.64% (5 years), 13.35% (10 years). Gross of fees: 7.62% (1 year), 12.48% (5 years), 14.21% (10 years).
decoys.why_ok: Net returns are shown first and in the same format as gross for identical one-, five- and ten-year periods ended June 30, 2026, which also satisfies the prescribed-period requirement.
